documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: The equipment maintenance account once asked about spreadsheet coordination. Current permission is withdrawn. Do not send outreach or create a seller follow-up.

There is no approved pricing, deployment timeline, or specific vendor connector at this time.
